source_note: Which pages a household answers together, and which each person answers alone (spec 6.8, agreed 15 October; the reasoning is in design/partner-seat.md). Deliberately apart from the workbook content, so changing what is shared can never disturb the content check. content-build/check-together.mjs refuses an unlisted page. Copied into the app by web/scripts/sync-content.mjs.

kinds.ours: One answer for the household. Either person writes it, and the page says who changed it last.
kinds.mine: Each person answers alone. Nothing is shown to the other until both have written.
kinds.read: Explanation only. There is nothing to answer, so there is nothing to share.

mine_fields.note: Fields inside a shared page that stay personal. A field is the unit an answer is stored under, so these need no new machinery: the page is shared, these boxes are not.

private_allowed.note: Personal pages a person may keep private for good, even after both have written. Used from slice 2 (the comparison).

agree_after.note: Personal pages that ask for one agreed answer once both people have written: a working direction you share, and a decision you make together. Used from slice 2.
